entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: Sequence of 524 aa has 56.6% identity and 98.3% query coverage to reviewed Acidovorax sp. UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase A1WC11 (EC 6.3.2.13).
Related reviewed homologs support ligation of meso-diaminopimelate onto UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu during peptidoglycan synthesis; annotation is inferred by homology, not direct assay of query protein.
Predicted Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains; homolog annotations report Mg2+ cofactor.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: ATP-dependent reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+ (Rhea RHEA:23676; EC 6.3.2.13).
